Nora (Marketing): FYI got a note from sales: 9 leads overnight sat unassigned >90s. looks like enrichment tail + RR skip. can we quick triage?
Eli (Sales Ops): agree, reps hit by this. what's current enrichment timeout?
Rae (Eng): enrichment_timeout_ms=12000, claim_window_ms=60000, overflow_after_ms=90000. issue was third-party NLU spike; quick fixes: lower batch wait from 150ms->40ms and add partial-route flag.
Sam (Support): support saw 3 tickets "lead not in queue". if partial-route set, can we tag missing_enrich=true so SDRs know to follow up?
routing-bot: alert: 2026-03-22T03:05Z - 9 unassigned leads >90s; enrichment P95=13.5s.
Nora (Marketing): proposal: enrichment_timeout_ms=8000, overflow_after_ms=60000, partial_route=true, hs_webhook_ttl_ms=10000. roll canary 5% for 12h.
Eli (Sales Ops): +1. shorter overflow favored by SDRs. please add owner-refresh to reduce stale mappings.
Rae (Eng): will open PR and add metric lead_route.outcome + tag missing_enrich. aiming to merge today.
Sam (Support): will add saved search for route_status=partial.
Nora (Marketing): thanks all 97 will monitor canary and loop back. post PR link in thread.
